name: New Braunfels
highlights: The Gruene Ice Rink and Holiday Ice Park is open November 21, 2026, to January 4, 2027, at $18 per skater with skates included, next to a lit evergreen miniature golf course.

Light Up Landa on Friday, December 18, 6 to 7:30 pm, brings lighted Landa Park Railroad train rides, lighted jeeps, food trucks and free pictures with Santa (Visit New Braunfels listing; price not listed).
Fischer Park pairs Santa's Holiday Garden ($25 per family, 4 to 6 pm) with a free Elf Movie Party at the Amphitheater on Saturday, December 12.
Two Nutcrackers play the same weekend: Ballet Texas at the Brauntex Theatre, December 17 to 20, and SCBD at the New Braunfels Civic Center, December 18 to 20.
Sundrop Springs Farm runs Christmas at the Farm on eleven nights from December 4 to 22, with a Trail of Lights and Santa from 6 to 8 pm.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in New Braunfels for 2026, and here is what he found: 16 family events in New Braunfels, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (Santa's Ranch) through January 4, with Photos with Cowboy Kringle (November 7 to December 19), Wassailfest (December 3) and Christmas at the Farm at Sundrop Springs Farm (December 4 to December 22) along the way. New in this update: Gruene Ice Rink and Holiday Ice Park in Gruene (November 21 to January 4), Christmas at the Farm at Sundrop Springs Farm (December 4 to December 22) and New Braunfels Renaissance Faire Christmas Weekends (December 4 to December 13). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in San Antonio. For the rest of the state, see our Texas Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? New Braunfels families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in San Antonio, which covers Zoo Lights, the Ford Holiday River Parade, Illuminate at the Botanical Garden and more.

What Rally found in New Braunfels

  • 16 Christmas events for kids in New Braunfels
  • 2 free events, including 25th Annual Gruene Pony Express Ride and Gruene Town Lighting and Christmas Market Days
  • Meet Santa: 8 chances, including Santa's Ranch (November 6 to January 3) and Photos with Cowboy Kringle (November 7 to December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Wassailfest (December 3) and Gruene Town Lighting and Christmas Market Days (December 5 to December 6)
  • Also on the list: 2 Christmas shows, 2 Christmas light displays, 1 train ride and 1 ice rink
  • Season: November 6 (Santa's Ranch) to January 4 (Gruene Ice Rink and Holiday Ice Park in Gruene)
